detail.longDescription: For folks who feel like Batman but are stuck using the internet like non-Batman people… Robin is for you. Robin comes in when you want a website to look the way you want it to, or when the functionality you need simply isn't there. Want your old favorite website to look like it did back in the day, when your Catwoman was 20 pounds lighter? One prompt. Want to add a button, change a layout, hide annoying elements, or automate something repetitive? One prompt. Robin lets you make the internet your own, automate it, and connect websites to your tools through MCPs. https://thisisrobin.ai/ It's currently available for Chrome and Firefox. Would love feedback from people who like messing with websites, userscripts, browser automation, or MCPs.
